name: vega-lite-maps
description: Use this skill when the user wants a map, choropleth or shapes in a Vega-Lite chart, or asks why such a map draws nothing, even if they never say geoshape or GeoDataFrame. It says to hand the chart the GeoDataFrame as it is, with no conversion to coordinates, which mark and encodings draw polygons, points or a second geometry column, and what Curio fills in. A map drawn by an Autark node is not this skill.
